evidence.t: Trail: Corbin Creek trail, 4.4 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
2 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-23, Region 4 Kootenay.

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-23: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

Nearby: Coal Mountain coal mine (Maps D13 and D16): No Hunting/No Shooting and No Shooting Areas on private property; company permission before entry, maps at the gate houses (synopsis page 41, 99%). Mine outline from OpenStreetMap (estimate).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 4 table (pages 39 and 40), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Pages 36 to 41 print no LEH list.

plan: Drive: from Cranbrook, about 103 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.47837, -114.67753, pull off on Flathead FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: the Corbin Creek trail stretch, 4.4 km one way. About 89 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
